text: {"lessons":["Selling at a gain feels satisfying, but I should decide whether to sell based on the stock’s prospects and my overall plan—not just whether it is above my average cost.","A few quiet months are a reminder that I do not need to trade often; holding is a valid choice when nothing calls for action.","I should judge my account as a whole, including cash and all five stocks, rather than treating each position as a separate win or loss."]}
